review_candidates.title: Firmware / Embedded Software Engineer – Linux Embedded, C/C++, Qt (M/F)
review_candidates.description: 🏭Chi siamo TME Group è un gruppo industriale in forte espansione che opera nel design, nel testing e nel manufacturing di prodotti e schede elettroniche. Ci occupiamo di Test Solutions, PCBA Production ed Electromechanical Assembly, e seguiamo il prodotto dalla progettazione fino alla produzione e al collaudo. Con tre sedi produttive in Italia e tre centri di Customer Service & Support negli Stati Uniti, in Cina e in Thailandia, TME Group è presente nelle principali aree strategiche dell’elettronica mondiale: Europa, Nord America e Asia . 👤Il ruolo Cerchiamo un/una Firmware / Embedded Software Engineer da inserire nel team di sviluppo firmware/embedded . La persona si occuperà di progettare, implementare e manutenere il software di sistema per piattaforme Linux embedded basate su SOM Variscite (famiglia NXP i.MX). Seguirà l’intero ciclo di sviluppo: dalla customizzazione del BSP alla scrittura dei driver kernel, fino all’applicativo in C++ con interfaccia grafica Qt. 📃Requisiti Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo firmware/embedded su Linux . Per il profilo senior: 5+ anni, con almeno un progetto completo su SOM/SBC Linux embedded. Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria Elettronica, Informatica o equivalente; in alternativa diploma tecnico a indirizzo elettronico/informatico con significativa esperienza sul campo . Linguaggi: C++ moderno (C++11/14/17: gestione della memoria, RAII, template, STL), C per kernel e driver, Python e Bash per scripting, automazione di build e test. Linux embedded: architettura del kernel (scheduler, VM, interrupt handling), cross-compilazione e toolchain (GCC/Clang, Buildroot, Yocto), Device Tree (DTS/DTSI), U-Boot (configurazione, porting, boot script), filesystem embedded (UBIFS, JFFS2, ext4, overlayfs), systemd Sviluppo driver Linux: Loadable Kernel Module, driver per I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, GPIO, DMA e gestione degli interrupt, interfacce userspace (sysfs, ioctl, udev rules), debug kernel (KGDB, ftrace, perf, dmesg). SOM Variscite / NXP i.MX: moduli DART/VAR-SOM su i.MX8/i.MX6, porting e customizzazione BSP, configurazione pinmux (iomuxc) via Device Tree, integrazione di periferiche custom su carrier board, Yocto / NXP MCUXpresso. Framework Qt5/Qt6: signals & slots, event loop, QObject; QML/QtQuick/QtQuickControls per GUI embedded; integrazione con display stack (eglfs, Wayland/Weston); Qt SerialPort, Qt D-Bus, Qt Networking; cross-compilazione per target ARM; Qt Creator, Qt Profiler, Valgrind. Protocolli: CAN/CANopen, Modbus RTU/TCP, RS-485, Ethernet embedded, socket TCP/IP, MQTT, gRPC, USB OTG; conoscenza base di PCIe. Build system e tooling: CMake (toolchain file per cross-compilazione), Make, Yocto/BitBake (layer, recipe personalizzate, SDK), Docker per ambienti di build riproducibili. Versionamento e CI/CD: Git avanzato (branching, rebase, submodule), GitLab CI / GitHub Actions, gestione delle dipendenze con Conan o vcpkg. Inglese tecnico, per leggere documentazione, datasheet e RFC. 🔹Costituiscono titolo preferenziale Test e qualità del codice: unit test (Google Test, Catch2), test Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), analisi statica (cppcheck, clang-tidy, SonarQube), memory analysis (Valgrind, AddressSanitizer). Hardware e debug: lettura di schemi elettronici e datasheet, uso di oscilloscopio e analizzatore logico, debug via JTAG/SWD, conoscenza base di secure boot e firma del firmware. Esperienza nei settori Difesa/Aerospazio, Industriale, Medicale, Automotive. Certificazioni: Linux Foundation Certified Engineer, Qt Certification, Yocto Project Developer. 🔹Competenze trasversali Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica (specifiche, note applicative, procedure di test). Attitudine al problem solving su sistemi a risorse limitate. Capacità di collaborare in team multidisciplinari (HW, SW, test, system). Familiarità con metodologie Agile/SCRUM in ambito embedded. 🫱🏻‍🫲🏻Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un team che segue l’intero ciclo di sviluppo, dal BSP all’applicativo. Un contesto industriale in cui il software lavora a stretto contatto con hardware, test e produzione. Inquadramento e retribuzione commisurati all’esperienza maturata, da definire in sede di colloquio. ✍🏻 Come candidarsi Inviare la candidatura tramite LinkedIn allegando il CV aggiornato. In alternativa, inviare il CV a: 📩 hr@tmesrl.net 📩 domenico.oliviero@tmesrl.net indicando nell’oggetto il titolo della posizione. La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77 e D.Lgs. 198/2006), di tutte le età e nazionalità (D.Lgs. 215/03 e 216/03). I dati personali saranno trattati ai sensi del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR).

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - Algeria
review_candidates.description: About Us Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot. Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide. The Flex is the biggest short-term rental operator in Algeria and the best in the country. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance and reporting into one platform, helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue and scale their portfolios. We are looking for a highly ambitious Software Engineer based in Algeria who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You will build, ship, automate and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams and their guests. If you are excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you. What you will build You will help build and scale Base360.ai, the platform powering every part of a short-term rental business: customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations and operational systems. Your work will span the full short-term rental lifecycle: listing distribution, pricing and bookings, guest stays, property operations and financial reporting. Your mission Build the core platform Design and develop scalable applications, services and APIs for reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences and property operations. Create powerful automations Build event-driven workflows that remove repetitive work, from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements. Develop AI-powered systems Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions and help operators manage their portfolios. Design API-first architecture Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers and customer systems. Integrate the ecosystem Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem. Solve complex operational problems Real-time reservation and availability sync Dynamic pricing intelligence Smart lock access and key management Automated guest communication across channels Cleaning and maintenance automation Owner reporting and financial workflows AI-powered monitoring and alerts Move fast and own delivery Own projects end to end: from understanding an operator's problem to architecture, implementation, deployment and ongoing improvement. Tech stack We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes: Python, FastAPI React, TypeScript Supabase, PostgreSQL AWS, serverless architecture OpenAI APIs, Twilio, Stripe Docker, GitHub Actions You might be a great fit if you have Experience building and owning production software Experience with Python, FastAPI, React or similar frameworks A solid understanding of APIs, databases and cloud architecture The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset Curiosity about AI, automation and operational efficiency A bias toward action, shipping and learning from real users Bonus points for experience with short-term rentals or hospitality tech, multi-tenant SaaS, booking channel integrations, AI agents, event-driven architectures, Supabase or AWS serverless. Why join us Build something meaningful: solve problems short-term rental operators face daily, with direct access to The Flex's operations to test ideas. Extreme ownership: real freedom and responsibility over technical decisions. Small team, massive opportunity: work closely with the founders and shape the product. Learn faster: software, AI, automation and hospitality operations, all at once. Performance-based rewards: competitive pay with real upside for exceptional performers. Remote in Algeria: work from any wilaya. We care about outcomes, not hours. This role is not for you if You want a slow-paced corporate environment You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement You need detailed instructions for every task You avoid ownership and accountability We are looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.
